label: Healthy
note: Baseline motion: running parts rotate together. Illustrative simulation.

label: Injector misfire
note: One cylinder stops contributing: uneven crank pulses. Illustrative.

label: Fuel starvation
note: Weak fuel delivery: rail pressure sags, output drops. Illustrative.

label: Crank knock
note: Excess crank/rod clearance: audible knock each revolution. Illustrative.
